title: Find a hand-painted sign that's older than you 🖌️
description:
Hand-painted shop signs are disappearing, replaced by vinyl and LED. Plenty are still out there, faded, chipped and still doing their job.

Find one that is still in place and older than you are, and take a new photo of it.

## Your claim must include

- A photo you took yourself of the sign where it stands, showing enough of the street or shopfront to place it
- The GBP URL for the sign's business
- How you know it is older than you: a date on the sign, an old photo, a local archive, or what the owner told you

## Rules

- Real photos only, no AI images or photos from the internet
- One sign per claim
- Stay on public ground, and ask before photographing people or the inside of a shop

## Winner

The best combination of sign and story wins. An old date you can prove beats a guess. A good story from the owner beats both.

Deadline: 30 days after this bounty is funded.
